d:
The structure of the ab workout is simple.
There are 7 exercises, each performed for 60 seconds. If you are a beginner and cannot make it through the entire minute, perform the exercise for as long as you can with good form. Take a brief break when needed and rejoin the workout when you are ready. Your goal is to gradually build up the strength and endurance to complete more of each interval without sacrificing the quality of your reps.
